textbookBox.concept: We celebrate 26 January as Republic Day. On this day in 1950 India decided to follow the Constitution, our special book of rules.

beats.en: We celebrate 26 January as Republic Day. On this day in 1950 India decided to follow the Constitution, our special book of rules.
beats.speakEn: We celebrate 26 January as Republic Day. On this day in 1950 India decided to follow the Constitution, our special book of rules.

beats.en: India became independent on 15 August 1947. Before that we were not free to take decisions ourselves, and many brave people struggled to make India free.

textbookBox.concept: A country needs rules to run smoothly and keep everyone safe and happy, just as a school does.

beats.en: In our flag, saffron stands for strength and courage, white for peace and truth, and green for growth and prosperity. The blue Ashoka Chakra at the centre stands for duty, or dharma.
